proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly records Lahnda and Punjabi bhārā “heavy” under bhāra, alongside Kashmiri bāra. These northwestern a/o-final adjectives fit that attested adjective family; they are distinguished from i-final bhārī under bhārika (9465). The Gojri o-ending is the regional masculine ending; cross-Indo-Aryan transmission remains unspecified.
